rationale: Gene-resolved MAGE-A12 RNA was detected in normal brain. A cross-reactive anti-MAGE-A3/A9/A12 TCR was associated with severe neurological toxicity including deaths. Hold clinical prioritization despite HPA screening compatibility.
limitations: Neuronal IHC used a pan-MAGE antibody and the TCR recognized multiple antigens; unique causal attribution to MAGE-A12 is not proven. This is a precautionary evidence-based hold.

rationale: Fatal cardiac toxicity involved an affinity-enhanced MAGE-A3 TCR cross-reacting with titin. Require receptor-specific cross-reactivity review; this does not establish MAGE-A3 expression in heart or a gene-wide contraindication.
limitations: Clinical experience with one receptor cannot be transferred to other receptors or modalities. A normal-expression screen does not test cross-reactivity.
